title: PENEX: AdaBoost-Inspired Neural Network Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2510.02107v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AdaBoost sequentially fits so-called weak learners to minimize an exponential loss, which penalizes misclassified data points more severely than other loss functions like cross-entropy. Paradoxically, AdaBoost generalizes well in practice as the number of weak learners grows. In the present work, we introduce Penalized Exponential Loss (PENEX), a new formulation of the multi-class exponential loss that is theoretically grounded and, in contrast to the existing formulation, amenable to optimization via first-order methods, making it a practical objective for training neural networks. We demonstrate that PENEX effectively increases margins of data points, which can be translated into a generalization bound. Empirically, across computer vision and language tasks, PENEX improves neural network generalization in low-data regimes, matching and in some settings outperforming established regularizers at comparable computational cost. translated_title: PENEX：受AdaBoost启发的神经网络正则化方法
translated_abstract: AdaBoost通过顺序拟合所谓的弱学习器来最小化指数损失，与交叉熵等其他损失函数相比，指数损失对误分类数据点的惩罚更为严厉。矛盾的是，随着弱学习器数量的增加，AdaBoost在实践中反而具有良好的泛化性能。在本工作中，我们提出了惩罚指数损失（Penalized Exponential Loss，PENEX），这是一种新的多分类指数损失形式，具有坚实的理论基础，并且与现有形式不同，它可以通过一阶优化方法进行优化，使其成为训练神经网络的实用目标函数。我们证明PENEX能够有效增大数据点的分类间隔，并可据此推导出泛化界。在实验上，跨越计算机视觉和自然语言处理任务，PENEX在低数据量情形下改善了神经网络的泛化能力，在相当的计算成本下与现有正则化方法持平，在某些设置下甚至优于这些方法。
tldr: 本文提出PENEX（惩罚指数损失），一种理论上可靠且可通过一阶方法高效优化的新型多分类指数损失形式，它能有效增大分类间隔并导出泛化界，在低数据量场景下显著提升神经网络的泛化性能。
